guidance.claim: Expect wage increment impact of 150 to 200 basis points next quarter.
guidance.quote: On the wage increments, you should expect a similar impact on what we have seen in the past annual increment cycle, which had been in the range of 150 to 200 basis points.
guidance.speaker: Samir Seksaria

guidance.claim: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.
guidance.quote: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.
guidance.speaker: Samir Seksaria

guidance.claim: Expect AI revenue to be net accretive to growth over time.
guidance.quote: For your question about AI, again, our expectation is AI will be net accretive, like to see the initial year, our attempt would be to ensure that we arrest the degrowth while the AI revenue increase.
guidance.speaker: Gaurav Rateria
